name: PhenoShared
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: The source diff adds two registry workspace members and makes phenotype-health a local dependency. Its handoff reports 81 members/310 crate directories, an excluded broken Python crate, and remaining external PhenoInfra references.
role: Pooled reusable foundation and accepted package home
concerns: The 81-member cargo-check result is author-reported, not native verification here. Directory count and member count are not comparable completeness measures.
The handoff calls the excluded Python crate harmless and strikes off repair without consumer/contract evidence. Excluded from compilation is not accepted disposition.
Stable repository ID1200273587 came from Pheno/pheno, while the handoff says formerly PhenoAI; distinguish rename from absorbed-source lineage.
Some dependencies still reference donor Git sources even where local copies reportedly exist.
The handoff claims absorbed PhenoFabric, PhenoLab and PhenoRegistry content while those retain their own chats; decide library versus product ownership per capability.

next_actions.title: Reconcile source identity and package inventory
next_actions.work: Index all languages/build systems, members, excluded packages and recovered copies. Assign retained/integrated/fixture/archive/unsupported status and source lineage by repository ID.
next_actions.acceptance: No file-presence or compilation-only absorption verdict; each retained public capability has a real owner/consumer/profile.

next_actions.work: Select a registry or runtime capability, establish authoritative API/source, resolve equivalent local/upstream dependency identity, and test a clean real consumer.

next_actions.title: Establish package-level release and reuse discipline
next_actions.work: Build/publish only authorized independent packages with bounded dependency cones. Qualify actual consumers, updates and rollback; adapt trusted tools rather than copying weak implementations.
next_actions.acceptance: Current/future-consumer impact record, compatibility evidence, no lockstep all-workspace dependency, no unrelated repo mutation.

ecosystem_contract: One PhenoShared chat owns integration, not every product. Coordinate PhenoFabric/PhenoLab/Registry/ShareCLI owners for source/consumer contracts; keep app-specific behavior outside generic foundations.
parent_acceptance: A bounded reusable capability can be installed and used by its actual consumers from a clean environment, with precise provenance and safe change semantics.
